data: What research question from the study is the graph addressing?

The graph addresses the research question of how the performance of the baseline multi-condition and invariance model varies with the number of noise conditions used for training. The key visual elements include the lines representing different conditions (Baseline avg, Inv avg, Baseline seen, Inv seen, Baseline unseen (wv1), Inv unseen (wv1)) and their trends over the number of noise conditions (# noise conditions). The relationships between these elements show that the performance of both the baseline and invariant models improves as the number of noise conditions increases, but the invariant model generally performs better than the baseline model across all conditions.
